title: Grateful Dead Live at Greek Theatre, University Of California on 1981-09-12
lineage: Master Cassettes (Nakamichi CR7-A) > Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.6 MHz)> dBpoweramp (24/96) > Adobe Audition CC 2019 > TLH flac2496
source: Mark Severson's Master (FOB) Audience Cassettes; 3 x Nakamichi 700 mics (cardioid left & right - X pattern; 75 degree angle; 6db bass EQ, omni center pointed straight at stage, 40' from stage, DFC) > Jamie Poris' custom made mixer > Sony D5

ai_review.summary: Terrific concert captured with an excellent audience recording; the Severson pull is hailed as the best‑sounding source.
ai_review.review: Reviewers rave about this show, calling it terrific and noting that the Severson audience pull delivers the clearest and most vibrant sound of the three available sources. The recording quality is praised as top‑notch for an Aud source, making the performance highly enjoyable.

ai_rating.rationale: Single enthusiastic 5‑star review highlights both a superb performance and excellent audience recording quality, leading to a high rating despite limited data.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer describes this Severson pull as the best‑sounding audience source among several, noting clear and vibrant sound.
